meta.coordinate_source: data.wa.gov.au PTA-001 (ArcGIS: https://public-services.slip.wa.gov.au/public/rest/services/SLIP_Public_Services/Transport/MapServer/14). Query by stopnumber (bus/CAT) or stopname LIKE (rail), outSR=4326. Exact stop/station coordinates, not approximations.
meta.scope_rule: Include a Transperth disruption only if at least one affected stop/station is inside the City of Perth local government area. In-scope rail stations: Perth, Perth Underground, McIver, Claisebrook, Elizabeth Quay, City West. All CAT services (Red/Blue/Green/Yellow/Purple) are in scope. Bus items are in scope only when an affected stop's suburb is Perth, East Perth, West Perth, Northbridge, Crawley, Kings Park or Nedlands. Metro-wide network timetable changes with no specific City-of-Perth stop are excluded.
meta.rendering: Data is also emitted to pta-data.js (window.PTA_DATA) which all three zone pages load via <script src>. On each weekly scrape, regenerate BOTH this file and pta-data.js. Each affected stop is plotted at its exact coordinate; pts = [ [lat, lng, stop name], ... ].
meta.zones: Each disruption carries zones[] = the board zone(s) its affected stops fall in, by suburb: east = East Perth; central = Perth CBD / Northbridge (incl. Perth, Perth Underground, McIver, Elizabeth Quay stations); west = West Perth / Nedlands / Crawley. Each zone page shows only disruptions whose zones include that page's zone; a disruption spanning two zones appears on both.
meta.note: Assessed record of Transperth (PTA) service updates relevant to the City of Perth. On each weekly scrape, refresh the list, re-assess new refs against scope_rule, look up exact coordinates for each named stop number via the coordinate_source, assign zones from each stop's suburb, recompute current/past status from stored end dates, and drop items no longer on the Transperth list.
